claim: BEETLA is the number of beetles allowed during the current wave — the per-wave quota (distinct from the concurrency cap).

source.verbatim: BEETLA:	.BLKB 1			;NUMBER OF BEETLES ALLOWED DURING THIS "WAVE"

claim: DELAY is non-zero to delay between waves — the inter-wave countdown.

source.verbatim: DELAY:	.BLKB 1			;NON ZERO TO DELY BETWEEN WAVES

claim: The per-wave beetle quota ramp compares SCORE2 against 7 (70,000): below it, one beetle per wave.
The terminal quota band loads Y with 0FD, then two INY make it 0FF (255) — 255 beetles after 700,000.
The computed quota is stored into BEETLA at wave start (STY BEETLA).
DELAY is armed before the next wave (STA DELAY), the 0x40 value loaded just above.
CHKEND decrements DELAY once per clear frame during the inter-wave pause (DEC DELAY).
SCORNG awards score; it first reads MODE to test for attract.
SCORNG is a no-op in attract mode — a negative MODE branches to the early RTS (BMI 30$).
SCORNG adds the awarded points into the first digit of the score (ADC X,SCORE0).
PTS holds the number of points for killing a critter — the value SCORNG accumulates.

source.verbatim: PTS:	.BLKB 16.		;NUMBER OF POINTS FOR KILLING THIS CRITTER
